title.narrative: FinaRD2036: Accelerating Investments in the Dominican Republic
FinaRD2036: Acelerando las Inversiones en la Repblica Dominicana

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo es contribuir a la movilizacin de recursos para el fomento de las inversiones productivas en la Repblica Dominicana en el marco de la iniciativa Meta RD 2036, utilizando a BANDEX como vehculo de innovacin financiera. Los objetivos especficos de desarrollo son: (i) fortalecer la capacidad financiera del BANDEX para movilizar financiamiento productivo, incluyendo crdito a MiPyMEs elegibles, principalmente a travs del sector privado financiero; (ii) mitigar los riesgos de crdito y otras barreras de acceso para promover la movilizacin de recursos para el financiamiento productivo; (iii) mitigar los riesgos cambiarios en las operaciones de financiamiento de inversiones productivas alineadas con RD 2036, principalmente para empresas que generan ingresos en pesos dominicanos, pero tienen deudas en divisas; y (iv) apoyar innovaciones financieras que permitan apoyar al pequeo y mediano sector exportador dominicano.

The general development objective is to contribute to the mobilization of resources to promote productive investments in the Dominican Republic within the framework of the RD 2036 Goal initiative, using BANDEX as a vehicle for financial innovation.The specific development objectives are: (i) to strengthen BANDEX's financial capacity to mobilize productive financing, including credit to eligible MSMEs, primarily through the private financial sector; (ii) to mitigate credit risks and other access barriers to promote the mobilization of resources for productive financing; (iii) to mitigate exchange rate risks in financing operations for productive investments aligned with RD 2036, primarily for companies that generate income in Dominican pesos but have debts in foreign currency; and (iv) to support financial innovations that enable support for the Dominican small and medium-sized export sector.
